theme_strategy.rationale: Electric & Neon archetype mixed with Glassmorphism 2.0 (Spatial UI, liquid glass). A deep void dark theme to amplify neon accents, giving it a premium immersive web game feel reminiscent of high-end titles on Poki or CrazyGames. Absolute prohibition on flat, generic light-theme SaaS aesthetics.

headings.rules: Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Do not use Inter or Space Grotesk for headings.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Add Google Fonts links to public/index.html or import in CSS. Use Unbounded for the game title, player names, and scores. Use Outfit for settings, history, and small labels.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-2xl with bg-black/40 and a delicate 1px border-white/10. Do not use pure transparent backgrounds if content scrolls under.
visual_enhancers.neon_glows: Construct neon effects using multi-layered drop shadows (e.g., drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(139,92,246,0.6)]). The X and O marks MUST have a strong outer glow matching their respective colors.
visual_enhancers.background_texture: Use the provided wavy abstract image, heavily darkened with a black/gradient overlay (bg-black/80 or gradient overlay), so it sits quietly in the background, offering ambient texture rather than distraction.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_layout: Bento Grid approach for the surrounding UI. Central 3x3 game board. Flanked by vertical glass panels for Scoreboard, Match History, and Game Controls.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8 or p-12 for main containers. Ensure the 3x3 grid has a healthy gap (gap-3 or gap-4).
grids_and_layouts.board_grid: The Tic Tac Toe board must be a CSS Grid (grid-cols-3) nested inside a premium glass container.

components.cell: Square aspect ratio. Deep dark glassmorphic button. On hover: slight lift, border glows slightly with the current player's color. On click: explosive ripple/pop animation.
components.turn_indicator: Pill-shaped glass container at the top, glowing subtly with the active player's color and showing 'Player X Turn' or 'Player O Turn'.
components.modals_and_overlays: Settings and Win Popup should completely abandon the default white card look. Use dark glass panels with glowing neon borders for all dialogs.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded, using 'The Tracing Beam' or a solid neon glow on hover. Never rely on generic Shadcn default button styling without heavy customization.

motion.board_entrance: Staggered fade-up for each cell using Framer Motion.
motion.mark_placement: Spring animation (scale up from 0 to 1 with a bouncy spring config) when X or O is placed.
motion.win_effect: Draw a glowing line across the winning cells. Fire canvas-confetti bursts from the center. Howler.js plays a premium 'success' chime.
motion.hover_states: Smooth transitions (scale 1.05, increase brightness of glow) on all interactive elements.

images.usage: Set as a fixed, cover background image for the main application container. Overlay with a dark mask (like bg-black/80 or radial-gradient) to ensure high text contrast.

media.icons_library: lucide-react for standard UI (settings, history, close). DO NOT use AI emojis.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the bright neon text on dark glass meets APCA standards. Use text-shadow if necessary for readability.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='cell-0-0', data-testid='restart-button', data-testid='difficulty-select'.
accessibility.motion_preference: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for heavy Framer animations.
accessibility.keyboard: The 3x3 grid MUST be fully navigable via keyboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: You have .js and .jsx files, not .tsx. Implement all React components as standard JavaScript (with JSDoc if you want types) or straightforward JSX.
Do not build a basic college project game. The entire screen should feel like an immersive neon arcade machine. Embrace extreme polish.
Use Howler.js for discrete, satisfying sounds: a subtle tick on cell hover, a satisfying pop on click, a win fanfare, and a tie buzz.
Implement a robust Minimax algorithm for 'Impossible' mode, ensuring it never loses. Add Easy (Random) and Medium (Heuristic) modes.
Save Match History (Player X vs Player O, Outcome, Date) and Scoreboard (X wins, O wins, Draws) in Local Storage.
Create a beautiful Landing Page (or full-screen modal intro) that transitions smoothly into the game board.
Ensure 'Player vs AI' vs 'Local Multiplayer' selection is intuitive and prominent.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component should be located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx` (adapt to js).
